figurative_meaning_en: An extremely auspicious time or period of prosperity
example_sentences_in_bangla: একাদশে বৃহস্পতির যোগে এই বছর ব্যবসায় লাভ হবে।
বিয়ের তারিখ ঠিক করতে একাদশে বৃহস্পতির দিন বেছে নাও।
example_sentences_in_english: With Jupiter in the eleventh house, this year will bring profits in business.
Choose a wedding date when Jupiter is in the eleventh for good fortune.
history: This idiom draws from Vedic astrology (Jyotish Shastra), where the 11th house represents gains and fulfillment of desires, and Jupiter (Brihaspati) is considered a highly benefic planet symbolizing wisdom and prosperity.
note: Common in Hindu astrological contexts in Bengal
